notes: All features from input_ui_spec.txt have been implemented. The project includes a complete Vue 3 + TypeScript setup with Vite, Pinia for state management, Vue Router with lazy-loaded routes, and a fully responsive design with dark mode support. All TypeScript types are explicit with strict mode enabled. The application follows accessibility best practices with semantic HTML, ARIA labels, and keyboard navigation. Mock AI responses simulate real-time chat experience with configurable delays.
